name: znetwork_dplay_get_enumerated_session_player_counts_by_index
description: zNetworkDPlay::GetEnumeratedSessionPlayerCountsByIndex fetches an enumerated DirectPlay session cache entry and writes maxPlayers/currentPlayers when the entry exists.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48a2e0 validates the __fastcall ECX=entryIndex EDX=currentPlayersOut plus stack maxPlayersOut ABI, global g_zNetwork_EnumeratedSessionList lookup through zArchiveList::GetAt, no writes for a missing cache entry, maxPlayers load from cache offset 0x30, and currentPlayers load from cache offset 0x34.
The native smoke verifies currentPlayers/maxPlayers writes for a present session entry and verifies both output variables remain unchanged when the requested entry is missing.
